title: Swap two variables
prompt: Swap the values of a and b, then report a, which now holds what b had: swap_and_return(1, 2) is 2.
hints: You need somewhere to keep one value while the other overwrites it: a third variable called `temp`.
Three steps: `var temp = a`, `a = b`, `b = temp`.
solution:
func swap_and_return(a, b):
	var temp = a
	a = b
	b = temp
	return a
